# A plain CAD transaction, and a USD account waiting beside it.
#
# The test that uses this rewrites the transaction into a USD purchase and
# re-imports it with `--strategy update`, which is how currency can arrive in a
# book through an edit rather than a fresh transaction. That currency needs a
# cost basis exactly like any other; without one it lists as `none recorded`, over
# a message saying this tool never wrote the split — which it just did.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Misc
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "To be corrected into a USD purchase"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Misc 135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
